gpt-5-mini.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development was not explicitly presented as a single 'movement in prior years' line in the notes; the prior-year movement was computed from the GROSS claims development table (claims development triangle) on page 37. The note titled "Change in the net provision for claims" reports gross and reinsurer components (gross = 44,774k) but is presented as the change in provision (including current-year movements). Therefore the triangle method was used as the most reliable way to isolate prior-year run-off (excluding 2015 & 2016). Exact textual description of a total prior-year movement is not present; IBNR valuation and FX phrases were used as causal evidence. Lob-level prior-year movements are not explicitly quantified in the report and are therefore reported as null with low confidence.
